privacy.title: Your learning account
paragraphs: TIH Learning uses your existing Tolbert Innovation Hub account. When you sign in, your email and password are sent over HTTPS to TIH’s Supabase authentication service. The app retrieves your student name, student ID, account status, and approved course access. Your password is not saved on your phone.

Session tokens and the last verified course grants are encrypted on the phone using Android Keystore. Signing out removes the active session. Verified offline access lasts up to seven days and must then be refreshed online.

privacy.title: Study records on this phone
paragraphs: Bookmarks, personal notes, practice quiz scores, and lesson progress are stored in the app’s private storage, separately for each student account. These study records do not currently sync to TIH’s website. Theme and reading-size preferences are also saved on this phone.

You can clear the signed-in account’s study records from the You screen. Signing out keeps those records for your next sign-in. Uninstalling the app or clearing Android app storage removes all local records. Android cloud backup is disabled for this app.

privacy.title: Network services and external apps
paragraphs: TIH uses Supabase to provide authentication and enrollment verification. Network requests expose technical information such as your IP address to the service handling the request. Server records are managed by TIH under its published privacy policy.

This app contains no advertising, analytics, or crash-reporting SDK. It does not request access to your contacts, location, camera, microphone, or photos. Written lessons and quizzes are bundled in the app. Videos and external learning resources open only after you tap them; the external service’s privacy practices then apply.
If you choose email, telephone, or WhatsApp support, your selected app handles the message or call. A deletion request is only sent when you send it from your email app.

privacy.title: Retention and deletion
paragraphs: Local records remain until you clear them or uninstall the app. To request deletion of your TIH account and associated server data, open Delete TIH account and send a request to the published TIH support email. TIH may need to verify that you own the account.

TIH’s published privacy policy provides deletion rights subject to legal retention requirements and says privacy requests receive a response within 30 days. The support team must explain any records that must be retained and why. Clearing this phone’s data alone does not delete your TIH account.

help.title: Signing in
paragraphs: Use the email and password of your existing TIH Learning Hub account. If an older account is not linked, or you need password help, contact TIH support. Never include your password in a support message.

help.title: A course is locked
paragraphs: Sign in and choose Refresh access on the You screen while connected to the internet. Only courses approved for your active student account are unlocked. Contact support if an approved course remains unavailable.

help.title: Studying offline
paragraphs: Written lessons, quizzes, bookmarks, and notes work offline after TIH verifies your access. Reconnect and refresh access at least every seven days. Videos need an internet connection and open in YouTube or your browser.

help.title: Progress and certificates
paragraphs: App progress and quiz scores are practice records saved on this phone. They do not update your website completion or issue official certificates. Official TIH completion and certificate decisions remain with the Learning Hub. Contact support about an existing certificate.
